overview: Obesity is a chronic condition characterized by excessive body fat accumulation that can affect overall health. It may result from genetic, lifestyle, environmental, and metabolic factors, and can increase the risk of conditions such as diabetes, heart disease, and hypertension.

Include protein and fibre with meals.
Drink water instead of sugary beverages.
exercise_recommendations: At least 150 minutes of moderate aerobic activity weekly.
monitoring_recommendations: Keep blood pressure, glucose, and cholesterol checks up to date.
0_5.clinical_warning: Discuss persistent unexplained weight gain or appetite changes with your healthcare provider.
0_5.positive_takeaway: You have a strong foundation for maintaining healthy weight and metabolism.
